_comment: Перки навыков героев (Мистик). heroes — у кого бывает ([] — у всех), max — сколько раз можно взять (0 — сколько угодно).

split.name: Split
split.desc: The skill fires ×3 projectiles and deals +20% total damage, split evenly between them.

wounds.name: Grievous Wounds
wounds.desc: Skill hits slow the target by 10% for good, up to 30%. Elites need 2 hits for each step, bosses 3.

poison.name: Poison Shell
poison.desc: Skill damage lands 5 s later, but is 50% higher.

heavy.name: Heavy Shell
heavy.desc: +1 s skill cooldown, +20% damage, the hit stuns for 0.7 s.

parry.name: Parry
parry.desc: Every 4 s your next strike reflects enemy projectiles back.

vandal.name: Vandalism
vandal.desc: The strike knocks enemies far away, but deals 50% less damage.

element.name: Element
element.desc: The skill gets an element of your choice.

trophies.name: Trophies
trophies.desc: A kill with the skill gives 1 coin and +0.2% skill damage until the end of the run.

smoke.name: Smoke Grenade
smoke.desc: The grenade turns into smoke of radius 300: 25% of its damage every second for 4 s.

precise.name: Precise Shot
precise.desc: The blessed shot homes in, flies 20% farther and deals 10% more damage.

economy.name: Economy
economy.desc: The turret gets 40% more rounds than it takes from you.

scientist.name: Mad Scientist
scientist.desc: The turret gets a random Synergis gun one rarity above yours. Nothing is taken from your reserve.

ready.name: Readiness
ready.desc: Dealing damage with the skill takes 1 s off the dodge cooldown.
